inference: Walk 3.5 and sprint 6.05 are the stored standing-pose speeds; knife-class fast sprint 3.5 x 2.05 = 7.175 stays an L4016 inference.
LMG sprint 6.05 x 0.95 = 5.7475 for tag members follows from the L4016 reading and the tag membership; the same tag membership as the site LMG class means the site can use its class flag.
ADS walk = 3.5 x the ADS ratio and firing walk = 3.5 x 0.8 are composition assumptions.
No stored value changed on 2.1.1.0 (L4056 recheck: soldier registry one row added, none changed; confirmed here for GS poses and GRX rows).
unresolved: needs capture: compiled resource 0550f387167b0bdd (2.1.1.0 SimEx_RootLayerLogic ResourceRef; old id 2bfca9f18b8f10e9). Without it the 0.95 LMG, 0.8 firing and 1.1/1.1818 constants and the FastSprintRequired logic are 1.4.3.5 readings only.

Gun walk/sprint: 6.05 equals the stored standing second speed; the L4016 graph would need a gun weapon input of about 0.931 that no file stores. Whether the graph or a native rule produces 6.05 is unread.
ADS-walk and firing-walk compositions (walk x ratio, walk x 0.8) are assumed, not read; whether 0.8 stacks with the ADS ratio is unknown.

LMG penalty: the flag that suppresses 0.95 (probably Support proficiency) and the stance compared are unnamed (L4016); which kits are exempt is unread. Tag membership is serialized; runtime use of the tag by the graph is inferred from the input names.
Other pose entries (3.0, 2.1, 0.9 and so on) have no confirmed pose-to-stance join; not proposed.
siteImpact: Proposal only; no site change made. Proposed: Mobility-group row Move speed (m/s) beside Strafe Spd (ui/app.js:1489): walk 3.5 / ADS walk 3.5 x _adsMoveSpeedMult / sprint 6.05 (5.7475 for the 11 LMG-tag weapons). If the 50 m sprint reads 8.26 s (+-0.3 s): add walk and sprint (new constants in data/balance_tables.json plus one sim field); LMG sprint only if it reads 8.70 s; ADS walk only if a 20 m ADS strafe is within 5% of the prediction. Otherwise nothing is added. No existing stored value changes: ADS_MOVE_TIERS, defAms and the displayed ADS ratio match the source index for all 67 weapons.
